svg.title: An online shop
svg.desc: Map: Phone, Laptop, CDN, Balancer, App 1, App 2, App 3, Redis, Postgres, Replica, Queue, Worker, Objects, Mail. Links: Phone, Laptop → CDN; CDN → Balancer; Balancer → App 1, App 2, App 3; App 1, App 2, App 3 → Redis (reads); App 1, App 2, App 3 → Postgres (writes); Postgres → Replica; App 1, App 2, App 3 → Queue (order); App 1, App 2, App 3 → Objects; Queue → Worker; Worker → Mail. Flow «purchase»: Phone → CDN → Balancer → App 1 → Queue → Worker → Mail. Flow «cache hit»: Laptop → CDN → Balancer → App 2 → Redis.
